evidence.description: Incident report 25-023498; date of incident Tuesday, March 18, 2025; time not reported; location Northwest Rochester, MN; premises type commercial premises.
Officers were dispatched to the commercial premises after police responded to an alarm at the business and met the reporting party.
Officer documented entry as an object thrown into the front entryway; court documents describe it as a bomb or a fire extinguisher.
Reporting party reported the loss of an ATM stolen from the building.
Stolen ATM was later recovered in Faribault, MN; the narrative says property was later recovered.
